Yone.build: Against an opponent who can engage immediately like Yone, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual. Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone P Way of the Hunter deal different damage types, and Yone W Spirit Cleave and Yone R Fate Sealed deal both, so don't rely on only one type of resistance if you build defenses. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so also avoid an option that only greatly increases your health.
Yone.combo: After Yone goes in, if you land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind while waiting for sleep to take hold, then redirect it to hit. Make Zoe Q Paddle Star! the first damage to hit the sleeping Yone, then follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Keep the order so your basic attack or missiles don't hit first before sleep.
Yone.escape: If only one of Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed is down, check whether he still has another mobility ability. In particular, during a window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back and after his other engage or crowd control abilities have been spent, close the distance with Zoe R Portal Jump and set up an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. First check that your return spot is safe.
Yone.fight: Avoid trading head-on; use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time while looking for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, save Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and look for a chance to hit him and use sleep to stop his return. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your original position, so don't count on it to escape Yone's engage.
Yone.laning: However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown and you're short on mana at this stage, so don't use it when the angle is likely to miss. Back off when Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado is ready, and use Zoe Q Paddle Star! from a position where it can hit both minions and Yone.
Yone.phase: After learning Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting one item, Zoe can land a powerful combo with a single hit. Zoe's burst remains strong in the late game, but Yone has his engage abilities available, so find a safe position first.
Yone.teamfight: Start from the farthest back, but check the formation so you aren't alone at the very back of the path hit by Yone R Fate Sealed. Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn't clip several of you at once. Use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! on enemies affected by your allies' immobilizing crowd control, and move forward after Yone's engage abilities have been spent.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. Yone R Fate Sealed may still be available after he goes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, so don't move forward just because one mobility ability is down. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves Yone behind the last champion hit, so before a team fight, check that you're not alone at the very back of the formation.

Ahri.teamfight: Start from the back and don’t move forward until Ahri R Spirit Rush has been used. Follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and hold your position with the traps left by missed bubbles and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. Look for a chance to target Ahri right after Ahri E Charm is down.
Ahri.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, while keeping in mind that magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.combo: After hitting Ahri with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it toward Ahri. Make Q deal the first damage to the sleeping Ahri, then follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Make sure your basic attack or W missiles don’t hit before Q.
Ahri.escape: The moment Ahri E Charm is down is your chance to attack. When Ahri engages, don’t rely on Zoe R Portal Jump as an escape; hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Ahri.fight: Right after dodging Ahri E Charm from behind the minions, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, you can briefly close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to look for a bubble, but you always return to your starting spot, so choose a safe starting position.
Ahri.laning: Stay behind the minion wave to block Ahri E Charm, and use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time. Don’t cast Q carelessly; use it when it can hit multiple targets, and throw Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Ahri steps forward. After clearing the wave, look for an angle from behind a wall, where the bubble’s range is extended.
Ahri.phase: After leveling E and completing one item, you can look to deal heavy damage off a single bubble, and an opportunity opens when Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable. Zoe’s burst remains strong late game, but first find a position where you can withstand Ahri’s engage.
Ahri.watch: Stay behind the minion wave to avoid Ahri E Charm, since getting hit makes it easy to take all the follow-up damage. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first pass. Watch for a dash while Ahri R Spirit Rush is available.

Anivia.combo: After hitting Anivia with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you to curve it around. Make Q hit as the first damage just as she wakes, then follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Make sure your attacks or W missiles don’t hit first and consume the double damage during sleep.
Anivia.fight: Don’t trade damage head-on for long; look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble after Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Anivia has no mobility, so if the bubble hits, close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to follow up. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, go in with an ally who can break the egg.
Anivia.phase: In the mid game, after Zoe levels E and gets an item, one bubble can threaten the opponent, and the window after Anivia P Rebirth has been used is a chance to get a kill. Late game, watch out for Anivia’s terrain control; Zoe’s durability barely increases, so find a position where you can survive first.
Anivia.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive early. Anivia’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance and choose Mercury's Treads.
Anivia.escape: Go in during the window when Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down. Anivia has no mobility, but Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so check that your return spot is safe before using it. If you’re chilled, don’t continue the fight; leave Anivia R Glacial Storm.
Anivia.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time, but cast it from a position where it can hit multiple targets. After clearing the wave, look for an angle to another lane with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a river or jungle wall, where its range is extended.
Anivia.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Fight in a wide lane rather than a narrow corridor, where Anivia W Crystallize can easily cut off your escape, and save Flash in case a wall separates you from your allies. Hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief until the opponent’s engage ability has been used.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes at its current location when recast, stunning enemies there, so don’t just sidestep its path; look for an angle from outside its range to begin with. If you’re hit by Q or chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow corridors, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health and stacks Stardust, so stay behind minions and quickly leave its line of aim. When low on health, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s area, where you risk being executed, and spread out from allies late game so multiple players aren’t hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.combo: Hit Aurelion Sol with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble while Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down. Wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it so it hits as the first damage when he wakes. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down is your window to go in with Zoe R Portal Jump. If Aurelion Sol E Singularity or the crowd control from R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is available, dodge its area first and look for a bubble angle after it’s down. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so make sure the return spot is safe too.
AurelionSol.fight: Don’t trade damage head-on; poke with Zoe Q Paddle Star! and look for an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to look for a bubble.
AurelionSol.laning: Early on, conserve mana and the cooldown of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and use Zoe Q Paddle Star! when it can last-hit and poke at the same time. If Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light keeps hitting you, you’ll contribute to his permanent growth, so stay behind minions or retreat outside its range. After clearing the wave, use the extended range of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall to affect another lane.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol is at his weakest early, before he has stacked Stardust, so after learning Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, look for chances to hit it and slow his growth. In the mid game, after completing one item, a bubble hit enables a strong combo. Aurelion Sol’s permanent growth puts Zoe at a disadvantage late game, so first find a position where Zoe can avoid his engage.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star!. Move forward to attack only after confirming Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight has been used; until then, hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. Spread out late game so multiple players aren’t hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility ability, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense, so the opening for Zoe to go in is right after Syndra uses E. Briefly close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to find a Bubble angle, while securing a safe starting point to return to with R.
Syndra.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Syndra's main magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots to gain movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, and E Scatter the Weak. Watch your total health too, to prepare for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, hit her with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward, then redirect it so Q is the first damage to hit Syndra while she sleeps. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Syndra.fight: Do not trade damage head-on for long; look for an opening right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Briefly close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star!, accounting for R returning you to the starting point.
Syndra.laning: Early on, dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere while using Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and harass at the same time. Q costs a lot of mana, so use it where it can hit multiple targets, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Syndra steps forward or after she uses E Scatter the Weak. After clearing the wave, move behind a wall and use the extended-range Bubble to impact a side lane.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Zoe's long cooldown on E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and low mana make a single mistake costly, so farm carefully. In the mid game, after leveling E and getting one item, a Bubble hit can lead to heavy damage, so look for an opening while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Zoe retains her burst in the late game but gains almost no durability, and Syndra's empowered abilities have different visual effects, so recalibrate your sense of distance.
Syndra.teamfight: Start from the far back and follow your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star!. When several Syndra Q Dark Sphere are set up, reposition and watch for Syndra R Unleashed Power. Do not move forward before the opponent's engage is used; hold a safe position with the Bubble trap and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between Zoe and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push the sphere and stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra W Force of Will deals a slow and true damage, while Syndra R Unleashed Power executes at low health, so keep your distance when your health is low. Also avoid areas where several spheres are set up during a team fight.

Hwei.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! when you can both clear minions and poke, and save your abilities if the opponent hasn’t stepped forward. If Hwei’s first spell hits you, move immediately to dodge his next spell. After clearing the wave, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind the river or jungle wall.
Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Hwei’s damage is mostly magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Hwei.combo: During a window when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for the sleep to take hold, fire Zoe Q Paddle Star! on a wide detour and make it hit as the first damage when the target wakes. Then use Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and hit with Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to close the gap. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your bubble’s range and go in. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, first find a position where you can avoid the root or forced movement.
Hwei.fight: Don’t trade damage head-on for long. Poke with Zoe Q Paddle Star! and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave, close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump and look for a bubble hit. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check that spot is safe before using it.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Zoe has little mana and a failed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is costly, so play carefully. Once you level E and get your first item, you can land a combo that deals heavy damage after a bubble hit. Zoe’s burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so secure a position where you can survive first.
Hwei.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up on enemies caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t go in while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available; look for an angle after it has been used. Until then, hold your position with the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you’re likely to take follow-up damage. If Hwei’s first spell hits you, move immediately to avoid his second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also avoid the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair and corridors covered by Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.

Akali.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali’s main damage is magic and Zoe has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Since Akali can engage immediately, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual.
Akali.combo: Hit Akali with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when her mobility is down or she is in a position where her movement is restricted. While waiting for the sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it so it hits the sleeping Akali as the first damage. Follow with an empowered attack and missiles from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Akali.escape: In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, you can briefly close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to look for a bubble angle. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so choose a spot where Akali can’t engage you there.
Akali.fight: After dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud or E Shuriken Flip is down, she can still escape with her remaining mobility, so don’t go too deep.
Akali.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time, and look for a bubble angle when Akali steps forward. After clearing the wave, throw Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall to extend its range and look for a chance to roam to another lane.
Akali.phase: After leveling Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and completing one item, one bubble can deal heavy damage, so look for a chance when Akali’s mobility is down. Zoe’s burst remains strong late game, but her durability barely increases, so first find a position where you can avoid Akali’s engage.
Akali.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star!. Don’t move forward while Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution is available. In the meantime, hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief, then move forward after Akali’s engage abilities have been used.
Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows you to wherever you run.

Akshan.build: Akshan’s main damage is physical and Zoe has low armor, so build armor first with Cloth Armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps. If you’re unlikely to survive Akshan E Heroic Swing’s engage, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual.
Akshan.combo: After hitting Akshan with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve and fire it. Make Q, your big hit, the first damage during the sleep, then follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Keep the order so your basic attacks or W missiles don’t hit before Q.
Akshan.escape: The moment Akshan E Heroic Swing is down is your window to go in. You can close the gap and attack with Zoe R Portal Jump, but you’ll soon return to your starting point, so use it only when that spot is safe. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is available, keep your distance using Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from the shards.
Akshan.fight: Don’t trade damage head-on with Akshan; look for an opening immediately after making him use Akshan E Heroic Swing. Then close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to line up Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, while accounting for your guaranteed return to the spot where you cast R. Pushing Akshan into the open makes it harder for him to engage or escape with E, which requires terrain to latch onto.
Akshan.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time, and look for an angle to hit Akshan when he steps forward. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so watch both its outgoing and returning paths even from behind the wave.
Akshan.phase: After leveling E and completing one item, look for a combo that deals heavy damage when E hits. Zoe’s burst remains strong late game, but her durability barely increases, so first find a position where you can avoid Akshan E Heroic Swing’s engage.
Akshan.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Move forward only after confirming Akshan E Heroic Swing has been used; until then, hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief shards. If you’re marked as a Scoundrel, don’t face Akshan alone; fight outside his finishing range.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so don’t assume you’re safe behind the wave; dodge both its outgoing and returning paths. Keep your distance near walls, where Akshan E Heroic Swing can let him engage. If you’re low on health and targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, don’t run alone into the open; hide behind terrain.

Ambessa.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Ambessa’s damage is mostly physical and Zoe has low armor, so build armor first. If Ambessa keeps catching you with immediate engages, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual.
Ambessa.combo: Hit Ambessa with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble after the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation ends. While waiting for the sleep, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it so it hits as the first damage when she wakes. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Ambessa.escape: Go in just after Ambessa has used her abilities and the charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. In particular, if Ambessa E Lacerate is down, look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble during the window when you’re less likely to be caught by its slow. You can briefly extend your range with Zoe R Portal Jump, but it returns you to your original spot, so check your engage position first.
Ambessa.fight: Counterattack just after Ambessa has used her abilities and the charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Stop attacking during the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, then catch her with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble after it ends and hit her with Zoe Q Paddle Star!. When closing the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump, account for your return to the starting point.
Ambessa.laning: Avoid trading damage head-on, and use Zoe Q Paddle Star! when you can last-hit and poke at the same time. After clearing the wave, look for an angle from behind a wall with the extended range of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
Ambessa.phase: Ambessa is strong in the mid game as she builds core items, so keep up in levels, hold your position, and don’t give her kills. Zoe’s burst remains strong late game, but her durability barely increases, so find a safe position before looking for an attack angle.
Ambessa.teamfight: Start from the back and don’t stand at the far end of a straight line within reach of Ambessa R Public Execution. Follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Move forward only after confirming Ambessa’s engage abilities have been used; until then, hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, don’t attack; walk out of its range. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, it’s difficult to dodge the blade tip of the following Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, so adjust your distance immediately. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest enemy champion in a straight line and can’t be interrupted by crowd control, so don’t line up with Ambessa when facing off against her.

Annie.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Annie’s damage is mostly magic and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: After hitting Annie with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it toward Annie. Make Q hit the sleeping Annie as the first damage, then follow with an empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Annie.escape: Don’t engage while Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready. After Annie uses her stun, pressure her with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Since Annie has no mobility to create distance, you can use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from range. Annie has no mobility to create distance, but Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check that the return spot is safe before using it to extend your range.
Annie.laning: Don’t trade damage head-on; use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time.
Annie.phase: Early on, Zoe has little mana and Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown, so a single mistake is costly. After leveling E and completing one item, a bubble hit can create a kill opportunity. Zoe’s burst remains strong late game, but her durability is low, so watch for Annie’s stun and engage and find a position first.
Annie.teamfight: Start from the back, and don’t stand clumped with allies while Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready or Annie is missing. Follow up on your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Move forward only after confirming Annie’s engage ability has been used, and keep your distance from summoned Tibbers.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania is ready to stun, stay outside Annie’s ability range. Spread out so multiple players aren’t hit by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, and keep your distance from the summoned Tibbers as well.

Aurora.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Aurora’s damage is mostly magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If you’re unlikely to survive Aurora’s engage, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual.
Aurora.combo: After Aurora uses a mobility ability, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While the sleep takes hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then curve it to hit. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! for the first hit while Aurora is asleep, then follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and Zoe W Spell Thief missile. If an auto or missile hits first, it consumes the doubled sleep damage, so keep this order.
Aurora.escape: Aurora uses W Across the Veil and E The Weirding to engage or disengage, and the window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes off cooldown is especially good for Zoe to go in. After moving out of Aurora Q Twofold Hex’s return path, close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump, but first make sure your return spot is safe. If Aurora jumps in and gets no kills, look for a chance to catch her with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble before she re-engages.
Aurora.fight: Avoid trading head-on, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Aurora steps forward. Don’t go deep just because Aurora has used one of W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, or R Between Worlds; account for her remaining mobility too. In particular, before Aurora R Between Worlds returns, you can extend your range and attack with Zoe R Portal Jump, but be sure to account for where you’ll return.
Aurora.laning: In the early game, use Zoe Q Paddle Star! for last hits and poke, but save mana by using it when it can hit several targets at once. Don’t waste Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered autos on minion last hits; use them to poke Aurora and finish her off. After clearing the lane, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, whose range increases when cast from behind the river or jungle wall.
Aurora.phase: Early head-on trades favor Aurora because Zoe lacks durability and mana, so don’t overcommit against her. In the mid game, after Zoe levels E and gets items, a hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble can create a kill opportunity. Zoe’s burst remains strong in the late game, but since Aurora has her mobility abilities, secure a safe position before looking for an attack angle.
Aurora.teamfight: Start from the back and cast Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star! onto enemies caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. Don’t step forward until Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, and R Between Worlds have been used; hold your position with the bubble trap and movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. If an ally is slain, Aurora’s leap cooldown resets, so don’t leave low-health allies behind as you retreat.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of its return path to avoid the second hit. The return damage increases the more health you’ve lost, so when low, back off before the curse returns. If Aurora W Across the Veil makes her stealth, wait briefly or place Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble at her expected landing spot. Decide whether to leave the area before Aurora R Between Worlds appears.

Azir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Azir’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads and build magic resistance. Zoe’s magic damage works well against Azir.
Azir.combo: After hitting Azir with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it toward Azir. Make Zoe Q Paddle Star! hit as the first damage when he wakes, then follow with an empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. Keep this order, since an attack or missile hitting first consumes the double damage on the first hit during sleep.
Azir.escape: After Azir has used Azir R Emperor's Divide, you’re less at risk of being pushed away, so go in and extend the range of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble with Zoe R Portal Jump. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to the original spot, so check the soldiers’ positions there too.
Azir.fight: There’s a brief chance to deal damage while the soldiers are still and before Azir recasts Azir Q Conquering Sands. Find an angle from beside or behind the soldiers, hit him with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and then pressure him with Zoe Q Paddle Star! instead of trading for long. Right after Azir E Shifting Sands, extend your range with Zoe R Portal Jump to attack, while accounting for the spot you’ll return to.
Azir.laning: Save mana by using Zoe Q Paddle Star! only from a position where it can last-hit and poke at the same time. Look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Azir W Arise!’s soldiers expire or Azir has spent his mana.
Azir.phase: Early on, Zoe has little mana and Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown, so a single mistake is costly. From the mid game, after leveling Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and completing one item, look for a combo that can take down Azir with one bubble. Azir gets stronger as the game goes on; even though Zoe retains her burst late game, watch for Azir E Shifting Sands and find a safe position first.
Azir.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up on an enemy hit by your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t move forward before Azir E Shifting Sands has been used; hold your position with the traps left by bubbles and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. In narrow corridors, don’t have multiple players engage in the same direction, so you aren’t all pushed back by Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Azir.watch: Move to the side when standing in the straight line of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise!, or you’ll keep taking damage. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves the soldiers and slows you, check their new positions. Avoid engaging in narrow corridors, where Azir R Emperor's Divide can push multiple players back at once.

Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia’s main damage is magic, and Zoe has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get through the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots.
Cassiopeia.combo: After hitting Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind while waiting for the sleep to take hold, then curve it so it arrives as the target wakes. Use the doubled first-hit damage on Zoe Q Paddle Star!, then follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and Zoe W Spell Thief missile. You can’t cast Zoe R Portal Jump inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so cast it outside the cloud if you need to extend your range.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so the moment after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to close the gap. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is available, don’t approach while facing her; turn away when you see its cast animation. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so make sure that spot will be safe before going in.
Cassiopeia.fight: In the early game, pressure Cassiopeia when she steps forward with Zoe’s P More Sparkles! empowered auto and a short trade. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, don’t continue the trade; back off until the poison ends. Once Cassiopeia W Miasma is placed elsewhere, look for an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend its range if needed.
Cassiopeia.laning: Don’t trade damage head-on for long. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! for last hits and poke, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zoe Q Paddle Star! costs a lot of mana, so use it where it can hit several targets at once. After clearing the wave, look for an angle to affect another lane with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, whose range increases when cast from behind a wall.
Cassiopeia.phase: Once Zoe has items, turn hits with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble into heavy damage. If you don’t build a lead, the mid-to-late game favors Cassiopeia, so look for openings from a safe position instead of facing her for long in the late game.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Start from the back and hit enemies caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Step forward after confirming Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere and the enemy’s engage ability has been spent. Until then, hold your position with the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, her E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals her more while you’re poisoned, so move out of range and re-engage once the poison ends. You can’t cast Zoe R Portal Jump inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so don’t step into the cloud. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze’s cast animation, turn away to avoid being stunned.

Corki.build: Build Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Corki’s main damage is physical, and Zoe has low armor, so build armor first. However, Corki P Hextech Munitions’ true damage can’t be mitigated by resistances, and if you’re within reach of Corki E Gatling Gun, your first priority is to move away.
Corki.combo: When Corki W Valkyrie is down, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for the sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then curve it so Q hits Corki first while he’s asleep. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and hit him with Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Corki.escape: The moment after you force Corki to use W Valkyrie is your time to go in. Close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, accounting for the fact that you return to your original spot after using R.
Corki.fight: Don’t trade damage head-on. Look for last hits and poke with Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Right after Corki uses W Valkyrie, he has no mobility available, so close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump and look for a chance to hit your bubble. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check that spot is safe first.
Corki.laning: Zoe Q Paddle Star! costs a lot of mana, so use it when you can get both a last hit and poke. After clearing the wave, look for an angle to affect another lane with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble’s increased range from behind a wall.
Corki.phase: In the first five levels, Corki’s base stats are low, so lane pressure and ganks are effective ways to deny him farm. Once Zoe levels E and gets her first item, she can turn one bubble hit into heavy damage. In the late game, Corki can build items and fire missiles from a safe position, while Zoe is fragile, so choose your position more carefully when using Zoe R Portal Jump.
Corki.teamfight: Start from the back and cast Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! onto enemies caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. Step forward after confirming Corki W Valkyrie has been used. Until then, hold your position with the trap left by a missed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief shards.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets near the first one it hits, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition so you don’t get hit by the third missile in a row. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so don’t stand your ground in front of him; move to the side.

Diana.build: Diana’s damage is mostly magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual so you can survive Diana E Lunar Rush’s engage.
Diana.combo: After the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for the sleep, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then curve it so Q deals the first damage while Diana is asleep. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and hit her with Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Diana.escape: If Diana uses E Lunar Rush to engage without a mark, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble during the window when she has no way back out. Right after Diana E Lunar Rush is down, you can extend your range with Zoe R Portal Jump and attack, but your starting spot must also be safe for your return. If you were hit by the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, Diana E Lunar Rush may be ready again, so don’t engage; create distance.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, if Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark, you have a chance to catch her with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Start trading damage after the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so don’t count on it as an escape.
Diana.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! where you can get both a last hit and poke, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Diana steps forward.
Diana.phase: Once Zoe levels E and gets her first item, her combo starting with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble becomes strong. Zoe’s burst remains strong in the late game, but first secure a position where you can withstand Diana E Lunar Rush’s engage.
Diana.teamfight: Start from the back and spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Use vision to block Diana’s flank angles, and don’t step forward before her engage tool, Diana E Lunar Rush, has been used. When an enemy is caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control, follow up with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star!.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves toward you, so dodge to the side instead of only backing away. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush’s cooldown resets, so immediately create distance. Don’t fight up close until the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone.

Ekko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Ekko’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to prepare for an immediate engage with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Ekko.combo: During a window when Ekko’s mobility is down, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While the sleep takes hold, fire Zoe Q Paddle Star! on a wide detour. Aim for Q to be the first damage to hit Ekko while asleep, then follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don’t rush your engage. Close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump during a window when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and R Chronobreak are both down and E Phase Dive has also been used. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so account for whether that spot is safe too.
Ekko.fight: Don’t trade damage head-on. Look for an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is available, stop chasing; attack by extending your range with Zoe R Portal Jump during a window when his R is also down.
Ekko.laning: In the early game, use Zoe Q Paddle Star! for last hits and poke, but save mana by using it when it can hit several targets at once. Avoid Ekko Q Timewinder’s return path, and stay out of the area when you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence. After clearing the wave, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall.
Ekko.phase: Early on, Zoe is low on mana and Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown, so mistakes are costly. Once you level E and get your first item, you can turn a bubble hit into a full combo. Zoe’s burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so secure a safe position first with Ekko E Phase Dive and R Chronobreak in mind.
Ekko.teamfight: Start from the back and cast Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star! onto enemies caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. Right after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, look to hit him with your bubble while his mobility is down, accounting for the delay before the sleep takes hold. Don’t step forward before Ekko’s engage ability is spent; hold your position with the remaining bubble trap and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Ekko.watch: When you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid the marked area to dodge both the stun and the shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder came from and move out of its return path. When you see the afterimage of Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly, even when health is low.

Fizz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Fizz’s main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Since Fizz is an assassin who can engage immediately, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual too.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and wait for the sleep to take hold. Send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then curve it so it hits Fizz first while he’s asleep. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered auto and Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Fizz.escape: The window after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down is when Zoe can counterattack. Once you confirm Fizz Q Urchin Strike has also been used, close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check that spot is safe first.
Fizz.fight: Look for a chance to use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and Zoe Q Paddle Star! right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, account for the possibility of him engaging before you close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump. Instead of trading damage head-on, only counterattack when Fizz steps forward.
Fizz.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! where it can hit both a minion and Fizz, getting a last hit and poke together. Early on, conserve mana and Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble’s long cooldown, and look for the moment when Fizz W Seastone Trident goes on cooldown after he misses a last hit. After clearing the wave, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, whose range increases when cast from behind the river or jungle wall.
Fizz.phase: Early on, Zoe is low on mana and Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown, so one mistake is costly. Once you level E and get your first item, you can land a combo that deals heavy damage after a bubble hit, so look for a window when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Zoe’s burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so secure a position where you can avoid Fizz’s engage.
Fizz.teamfight: Start behind your team, close to your allies, and cast Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! onto enemies caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. Make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him down with your allies; until then, don’t step forward or chase alone. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before it erupts.
Fizz.watch: Fizz Q Urchin Strike and Fizz E Playful / Trickster are both engage tools, so don’t step forward just because one of them is down. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your original spot, so don’t count on it as an escape from Fizz’s engage.

Galio.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Galio’s damage is mostly magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Galio.combo: Hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble after Galio W Shield of Durand finishes charging and you’re outside taunt range. While waiting for the sleep, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then curve it so it hits the target first as they wake. Then hit with an empowered auto and Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Galio.escape: Don’t go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; check whether Galio R Hero’s Entrance is still available too. In particular, close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump during a window before Galio R Hero’s Entrance returns when Galio E Justice Punch and W Shield of Durand are also down. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so make sure your return spot is safe too.
Galio.fight: Avoid trading head-on. Poke with Zoe Q Paddle Star! and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Galio steps forward. Stop attacking while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging and move out of taunt range. After Galio E Justice Punch and R Hero’s Entrance are down, close the gap and attack with Zoe R Portal Jump.
Galio.laning: Use Galio’s melee range to pressure him from a distance, but save mana by using Zoe Q Paddle Star! when you can get both a last hit and poke. If Galio uses his abilities to clear the wave and spends mana, push the lane to limit his chance to use his ultimate to affect another lane. After clearing the wave, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, whose range increases when cast from behind the river or jungle wall.
Galio.phase: Galio is melee and vulnerable to poke early, but Zoe also needs to avoid mistakes because Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown and she is low on mana. Once Zoe levels E and gets her first item, she can land a combo that deals heavy damage from one bubble hit. Zoe’s burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so position with Galio E Justice Punch and R Hero’s Entrance in mind.
Galio.teamfight: Start from the back and follow up with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! after an enemy is caught in your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. Move out of range when you see Galio R Hero’s Entrance’s landing marker, and step forward after confirming Galio E Justice Punch and R Hero’s Entrance have been used. Until then, use the trap left by a missed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief to hold a safe position.
Galio.watch: Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its backward windup, and stand near a wall to shorten its charge distance. When Galio charges W Shield of Durand, damage is reduced and the taunt lasts longer, so don’t commit your damage; move out of range. Avoid the point where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap, and immediately walk out of range when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance.

Irelia.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first, then get Plated Steelcaps. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Zoe has low armor, so build armor first. If you need to withstand Irelia’s instant engage, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual.
Irelia.combo: After Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far away while waiting for the sleep to take hold, then redirect it toward Irelia. Time it so Q deals the first damage during sleep, then follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Don’t let a basic attack or W missile hit before Q.
Irelia.escape: Right after making Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge, if Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so don’t count it as an escape tool.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used is your chance to close the gap and fight. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, but account for R returning you to your starting point, including where you’ll land. Don’t trade damage head-on for long.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between Irelia and Zoe, and back away when minions are about to die. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! from a position where you can last-hit and poke at once, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Irelia steps forward.
Irelia.phase: Once you level E and complete one item, Zoe’s E hit combo becomes strong. Zoe’s burst remains potent later on, but she is fragile, so first find a position where you can avoid Irelia Q Bladesurge’s engage.
Irelia.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and don’t step forward until Irelia Q Bladesurge has been used. Follow up your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and prioritize Irelia when a team fight starts. Before engaging, hold your position using the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain-dash to low-health minions to close the gap, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch for Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then get Mercury’s Treads. Karma’s main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down, hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then redirect it toward Karma. Time its arrival so Zoe Q Paddle Star! deals the first damage during sleep, then follow with an empowered attack and Zoe W Spell Thief’s missile. Don’t let an attack or missile hit first and consume the double damage from sleep.
Karma.escape: Don’t go in while Karma W Focused Resolve is available; if it connects, create distance before the root. When Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from empowered Karma E Inspire has ended, use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap. Use the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief to get out, and don’t count Zoe R Portal Jump as an escape.
Karma.fight: Zoe should avoid trading head-on and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Karma steps forward. Attack after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from empowered Karma E Inspire has ended, using Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so first check that it’s safe.
Karma.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at once, but cast it when you can hit multiple targets so you don’t run low on mana. Position behind minions or outside its range to reduce hits from Karma Q Inner Flame. After clearing the wave, move behind a wall and look for an angle to intervene in a side lane with the increased range of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
Karma.phase: Early head-on trades favor the opponent because Zoe lacks durability and mana, so focus on farming and finding angles for Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Once you level Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and complete one item, a single hit can lead to heavy damage. Zoe’s burst remains potent later on, but her durability barely increases, so find a safe position first.
Karma.teamfight: Zoe starts from the farthest back and follows up her allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Wait to engage while Karma W Focused Resolve is available or just after the shield from empowered Karma E Inspire is applied. Hold your position with the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief until the enemy’s engage ability has been used.
Karma.watch: If you take Karma Q Inner Flame for free, Karma P Gathering Fire brings R Mantra back sooner, so reposition behind minions or outside its range. Don’t stay where empowered Karma Q Inner Flame detonates; walk out of the circle. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance before the root and break the tether.

Kassadin.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then get Mercury’s Treads. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance. If the threat of an instant engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk grows, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Wait for sleep to take hold, sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind before redirecting it so it deals the first damage to the sleeping target. Then follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and hit with a Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Kassadin.escape: While Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump. If Kassadin E Force Pulse’s slow is also down, find a position to hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Consecutive casts of Kassadin R Riftwalk cost more mana, so punish him if he runs out of mana while chasing.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, poke with Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Kassadin steps forward. While Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you can use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap and attack. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so first check that it’s safe.
Kassadin.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! from a position where you can last-hit and poke at once, but don’t cast unnecessary spells near Kassadin and speed up the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse. After clearing the wave, find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a river or jungle wall.
Kassadin.phase: In mid game, after Zoe levels E and acquires items, turn a Sleepy Trouble Bubble hit into heavy damage. Kassadin R Riftwalk’s engage is dangerous later on, so Zoe should find a safe position before looking for an attack angle.
Kassadin.teamfight: Zoe starts from the back and follows up targets affected by her allies’ immobilizing effects with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t step forward alone while Kassadin R Riftwalk is available; hold your position using the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. Step forward after confirming Kassadin R Riftwalk has been used.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Zoe’s magic poke, so deal damage after Q is down. Watch for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse and the engage from Kassadin R Riftwalk. Don’t stand alone within its range while Kassadin R Riftwalk is available.

Leblanc.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then get Mercury’s Treads. LeBlanc’s main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual to prepare for an instant engage with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Leblanc.combo: When LeBlanc W Distortion is down, hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then redirect it so Zoe Q Paddle Star! deals the first damage during sleep. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Leblanc.escape: LeBlanc W Distortion is used to engage and move, so right after she uses it is your chance to close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump. If the time for LeBlanc to return has expired or she has already returned, and LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is also down, look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
Leblanc.fight: Instead of trading damage head-on, look for an opening after LeBlanc W Distortion is down. If the time for LeBlanc to return has expired or she has already returned, use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap and find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check that it’s safe first.
Leblanc.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at once, but cast it when you can hit multiple targets to save mana. Look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when LeBlanc steps forward, and back away if LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you. If LeBlanc disappears from mid lane vision, alert your team immediately. After clearing the wave, find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall.
Leblanc.phase: Once you level Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and complete one item, one bubble hit can lead to a strong combo. Zoe’s burst remains potent later on, but her durability barely increases, so watch for LeBlanc W Distortion and find a safe position first.
Leblanc.teamfight: Zoe starts from the farthest back and follows up targets hit by her allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t step forward before LeBlanc W Distortion has been fully spent. Hold your position using the trap left by a missed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. Step forward to find an attack angle after confirming LeBlanc W Distortion is down.
Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is still on you, the next spell will deal more damage, so back away and wait for the mark to disappear. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits, you can use Zoe R Portal Jump to get out of chain range before the root, but account for returning to your starting point. If LeBlanc appears as two after losing health, identify which one is actually attacking before using your spells.

Lissandra.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand the lane. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage and Zoe has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance, then get Mercury’s Treads.
Lissandra.combo: Hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Lissandra E Glacial Path is down or after she uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost. Wait for sleep to take hold, sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind before redirecting it to deal the first damage as the target wakes. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, she can cast it on herself to avoid damage, so stagger your damage through the moment her stasis ends.
Lissandra.escape: Right after making Lissandra use Lissandra E Glacial Path is your window to close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, it’s easier to find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble without worrying about its root. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is still traveling, check whether sleep can take hold before she recasts it; if not, throw the bubble toward the spot where she’ll teleport.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. If Lissandra E Glacial Path has also been fully spent, extend your range with Zoe R Portal Jump and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so use it only when that spot is safe.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid Lissandra Q Ice Shard’s piercing path. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! from a position where you can last-hit and poke at once, and don’t cast it so often that you run low on mana. After clearing the wave, look for an angle for the increased range of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a river or jungle wall.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Zoe should avoid trading head-on because Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble has a long cooldown and she lacks mana. Once you level Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and complete one item, the combo following a bubble hit becomes strong. Zoe’s burst remains potent later on, but her durability barely increases, so first find a position where you can avoid Lissandra E Glacial Path’s engage.
Lissandra.teamfight: Zoe starts from the farthest back and hits targets affected by her allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t step forward while Lissandra E Glacial Path is available; hold your position using the bubble trap and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. Step forward and attack after confirming Lissandra E Glacial Path has been fully spent.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting its first target, so don’t stand in a line with allied minions. Being caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun is dangerous, so don’t use Zoe R Portal Jump to get close while both abilities are available. When Lissandra E Glacial Path travels, watch where it can be recast and whether she’ll engage.

Lux.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Lux’s magic damage. Get Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Wait for sleep to take hold, sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind before redirecting it so it hits the target with the first damage as they wake. Follow with an empowered attack and hit with a Zoe W Spell Thief missile.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility spell, so right after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to close the gap. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to go in and cast your spells, but first check that your starting spot is safe because you’ll return there.
Lux.fight: Instead of trading damage head-on, bait Lux Q Light Binding, dodge it, then attack. At that moment, use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range and find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, accounting for the return to your starting point when R ends.
Lux.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit minions and poke at once, casting it where it can hit multiple targets so you don’t run low on mana. Spread out to the side from your allies so you can dodge Lux Q Light Binding, and if Lux’s spells hit you, keep your distance so Lux can’t detonate her Illumination mark with an attack. After clearing the wave, find an angle for the increased range of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall.
Lux.phase: Once you level E and complete one item, a single bubble hit can lead to heavy damage. Your burst remains potent later on, but your durability barely increases, so find an angle from a safe position.
Lux.teamfight: Zoe starts from the farthest back and follows up targets affected by her allies’ immobilizing effects with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t group up with allies and get caught together in Lux E Lucent Singularity. Don’t step forward before the enemy’s engage ability is used; hold your position using the bubble trap and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits, Lux can follow with more spells, so bait it out and move after it misses. It roots up to the first two targets it hits, so don’t stand in a line with allies. Move out of the area affected by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.

Malzahar.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, then get Mercury’s Treads. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to prepare for Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.combo: First break Malzahar P Void Shift, then hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Wait for sleep to take hold, sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind before redirecting it to hit sleeping Malzahar with the first damage. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attacks and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no mobility spell to create distance, so go in while Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and after breaking Malzahar P Void Shift. While Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, account for Zoe R Portal Jump returning you to your starting point even if you use it to approach. If the voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them first with Zoe Q Paddle Star! before engaging.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, damage and crowd control are less effective, so break it first, then look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Your chance comes when Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and the voidlings have disappeared. Zoe R Portal Jump can extend your range, but it returns you to your starting point, so don’t use it from a position where Malzahar R Nether Grasp can catch you.
Malzahar.laning: Move a step away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions and wait until the transfers are over. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at once, casting it where it can hit multiple targets so you don’t run low on mana. If Malzahar pushes the lane, call your jungler and engage together after breaking Malzahar P Void Shift.
Malzahar.phase: Once you level E and complete an item, you can deal heavy damage after hitting with the bubble, so pressure Malzahar early. Malzahar grows stronger over time, and Zoe remains fragile later on, so find a safe position first for late fights.
Malzahar.teamfight: Zoe starts from the farthest back and follows up her allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Don’t step forward while Malzahar R Nether Grasp and the enemy’s engage abilities are available; hold your position using the bubble trap and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so don’t try to last-hit beside that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outward from between the two rifts, and don’t engage before the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression can’t be cleansed with Zoe R Portal Jump, so don’t walk alone through areas without vision while Malzahar can cast R.

Mel.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then get Mercury’s Treads. Mel’s main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, hit with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Wait for sleep to take hold, sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind before redirecting it to hit sleeping Mel with the first damage. Then follow with an empowered attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility spell, so the moment Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down is your chance to go in. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to briefly close the gap and extend the range of your bubble or star, accounting for the return to your starting point.
Mel.fight: Instead of continuously trading damage head-on, sidestep Mel E Solar Snare, then find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Bait out Mel W Rebuttal with an attack, confirm it’s down, then use the bubble and Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Mel has no mobility spell, but Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so use it to extend your range briefly.
Mel.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at once, and look for an angle for the bubble when Mel steps forward. Push the lane and pressure Mel early to limit the time she has to stack.
Mel.phase: In mid game, once Zoe has leveled her bubble and acquired items, one hit can lead to heavy damage. Mel grows stronger as she stacks, making the matchup increasingly unfavorable for Zoe later on, so secure a safe position before dealing damage then.
Mel.teamfight: Zoe starts from the farthest back and follows up targets affected by her allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. If Mel W Rebuttal is available, don’t rush to throw your main projectiles. Only step forward after the enemy’s engage ability has been used, and hold your position using the remaining bubble trap and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles, so check whether she has used it before throwing Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Mel E Solar Snare roots you if it hits the center, so sidestep it. If you’re rooted, watch for the follow-up Mel Q Radiant Volley.

Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Zoe has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual to prepare for Naafiri's instant engage.
Naafiri.combo: After hitting Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward while the target falls asleep, then redirect it to hit as the first damage during sleep. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. Keep this order so the attack or missile does not land before Q and consume the first hit during sleep.
Naafiri.escape: Do not go in just because one ability is down if Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit are still available. In particular, before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes off cooldown, use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap when her other mobility abilities have also been spent. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, attack once she becomes targetable again.
Naafiri.fight: Avoid trading head-on and look for an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Naafiri steps forward. Clear the pack revived by Naafiri E Eviscerate with Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and attack after Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit are down. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns her to the starting point, so use it only to extend your range from a safe position.
Naafiri.laning: Farm from behind the minion line so Naafiri E Eviscerate has no angle to reach you. After clearing the wave, look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from the river or behind a jungle wall.
Naafiri.phase: After you get one item and level up E, you can kill an opponent with a single Bubble combo, but watch for Naafiri's engage and maintain wide vision while roaming in the mid game. Zoe keeps her burst in the late game, but gains almost no durability, so group with your team and secure a safe position first.
Naafiri.teamfight: Start from the far back and follow your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Q Paddle Star!. Before Naafiri's engage is used, hold your position with the Bubble trap and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed. Immediately retreat after an ally dies, since Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit can be cast again then.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate also revives her pack in addition to dashing and healing, so watch for the pack when it reappears right after she uses it. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she cannot be targeted, so attack after it ends. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is ready, do not roam alone.

Neeko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand the damage. Neeko's main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Neeko.combo: After hitting Neeko with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward while waiting for sleep to take hold, then redirect it. Time it so Zoe Q Paddle Star! deals the first damage during sleep, then follow with an empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. Make sure the attack or missile does not land first and consume the first hit during sleep.
Neeko.escape: The window for Zoe to close the gap is after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and R Pop Blossom are down.
Neeko.fight: Do not trade damage head-on for long. Look for an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Neeko steps forward. You can close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump to attack while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs or R Pop Blossom is down. Zoe R Portal Jump returns to its starting point, so do not go in if the return spot is dangerous.
Neeko.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and harass at the same time, casting where it can hit multiple targets to conserve mana. After clearing the wave, move to the river or behind a jungle wall and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, whose range increases.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, Zoe retains her burst, but you need to secure a position where you can avoid Neeko R Pop Blossom first.
Neeko.teamfight: Start from the far back and follow your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. If a disguised opponent using Neeko P Inherent Glamour closes in, spread out instead of waiting to see Neeko R Pop Blossom's cast animation. Move forward after confirming Neeko R Pop Blossom has been used. Until then, hold your position with the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so do not stand on top of an ally or behind them where the same ability could hit you next. If an unexpected enemy champion approaches after Neeko disappears from vision, watch for the possibility that Neeko P Inherent Glamour has disguised her. If a suspicious opponent closes in, spread out in advance instead of waiting for Neeko R Pop Blossom, whose cast animation may not be visible.

Orianna.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Orianna's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Orianna.combo: After hitting Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward while the target falls asleep, then redirect it to them. Make Zoe Q Paddle Star! deal the first damage during sleep, then follow with an empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. Make sure the attack or missile does not land first and consume the doubled damage during sleep.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so the opening to approach is when Orianna R Command: Shockwave and W Command: Dissonance are down. You can extend your range to attack with Zoe R Portal Jump, but it always returns you to your original position, so check that the spot is safe first.
Orianna.fight: Look to trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, when she no longer has Orianna E Command: Protect's passive defensive stats. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range and find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, accounting for the fact that you will soon return to the starting point.
Orianna.laning: Early on, do not let Orianna P Clockwork Windup's repeated attacks hit you; trade with abilities. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and harass at the same time, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Orianna steps forward or after she throws the ball. Do not spam Zoe Q Paddle Star! and run low on mana.
Orianna.phase: After leveling Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting an item, turn a Bubble hit into a burst of damage. In the late game, Zoe retains her burst but has low durability, so secure a safe position first.
Orianna.teamfight: Start from the far back, check where Orianna's ball is, and avoid the range of Orianna R Command: Shockwave. When an ally lands an immobilizing effect, follow up with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Do not move forward before the opponent's engage is used; hold your position with the Bubble trap and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed.
Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna Q Command: Attack places the ball, and leave the area around it because Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in there. Also watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and repeated attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana deals mostly physical damage, and Zoe has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Prioritize armor over building magic resistance specifically for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape. Since she is an assassin who engages instantly, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual.
Qiyana.combo: After dodging Qiyana's engage, hit her with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! on a long detour before firing it toward her, and make Q land as the first damage when she wakes. Follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile, assigning sleep's doubled damage to Q.
Qiyana.escape: Go in after both Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity are down, especially before E Audacity comes back. If Qiyana with the river element is looking to root you with Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, first retreat beyond its range. Zoe R Portal Jump returns to its starting point, so do not rely on it as an escape.
Qiyana.fight: Do not go in when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, since she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. After she uses both mobility abilities, hit the Qiyana left in front of you with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble to counterattack. When using Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap, account for the fact that you must return to the starting point.
Qiyana.laning: Avoid trading head-on. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and harass while looking for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Q Paddle Star! costs a lot of mana, so cast it where it can hit multiple targets, and look for an opening when Qiyana steps forward or just after she uses an ability. After clearing the wave, you can find an angle for E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall, where its range increases.
Qiyana.phase: Early on, Zoe's long cooldown on E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and low mana make a single mistake costly, so play carefully.
