Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving her an advantage in the early and mid game and build armor. Qiyana is relatively weaker in the late game, but Zoe gains almost no durability either, so group up while keeping away from terrain.
Qiyana.teamfight: Start from the far back and follow your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Do not move forward before Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity are used; hold your position with the Bubble trap and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed. Even while grouped with allies, stand away from terrain so you do not get caught by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can lead to a root or stealth depending on the element. If she approaches with the river element, retreat beyond her range; if she disappears with the brush element, move into allied vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits terrain and stuns, so do not face her with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage.

Ryze.build: Ryze's main damage is magic, and Zoe has low magic resistance. Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Ryze.combo: After hitting Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward while waiting for sleep to take hold, then redirect it toward Ryze. Make Zoe Q Paddle Star! land as the first damage when Ryze wakes, then follow with an empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. Keep this order because the attack or missile landing first consumes the doubled damage on the first hit during sleep.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you instead of rooting you, so look for an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble then. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your original position, so keep the return location safe when you go in.
Ryze.fight: When Ryze steps forward, use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and harass, and fight when you have an angle to hit Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If Ryze R Realm Warp is down, you can close the gap with Zoe R Portal Jump, accounting for the fact that it always returns you to the starting point.
Ryze.phase: After leveling Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting one item, Zoe can deal heavy damage with a single hit, so pressure Ryze before he scales. Zoe retains her burst in the late game but gains almost no durability, so watch Ryze R Realm Warp and secure a safe position first.
Ryze.teamfight: Start from the far back and follow your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, move away from your allies, and do not move forward with Zoe R Portal Jump before Ryze R Realm Warp is used. Until then, hold your position with the Bubble trap and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux, and if it hits, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears.

Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and Zoe has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual to prepare for being engaged on by Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct.
Sylas.combo: When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, hit him with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward, then redirect it to hit. Time it so Zoe Q Paddle Star! deals the first damage during sleep, then follow with Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile. If the attack or missile lands first, it consumes the sleep damage bonus you could have used on your biggest hit.
Sylas.escape: The chance to go in comes right after dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Check whether Sylas W Kingslayer is also down, and especially use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap and look for a Bubble before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to the starting point, so make sure the return spot is safe too.
Sylas.fight: Do not trade damage head-on. Counterattack after dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, he can heal and escape, so do not rush to finish him. Before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back, you can extend your range with Zoe R Portal Jump and find an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
Sylas.phase: After leveling Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting one item, you can deal heavy damage with one hit, so look for an opening when Sylas's mobility is down. In the late game, Zoe retains her burst but gains almost no durability, so secure a position where you can avoid Sylas's engage first.
Sylas.teamfight: Start from the far back and follow your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. If Sylas dives in with E Abscond / Abduct, add crowd control to create a chance to kill him before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. Do not move forward before confirming that Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct have been used; hold your position with the Bubble trap and Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed.
Sylas.watch: The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but if you are hit by the chains that follow, you are knocked up and take a chain of attacks. Watch the first dash and manage your distance so you can dodge the second chain. Sylas Q Chain Lash's intersection explodes later, so move away even if the first chain only grazes you.

Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Talon's physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than usual to prepare for Talon's instant engage. Talon has relatively high magic resistance, so add penetration to your damage or use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble's magic resistance reduction and true damage.
Talon.combo: After hitting Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or backward while the target falls asleep, then redirect it to hit. Make sure the first damage during sleep comes from Q by using Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered attack and a Zoe W Spell Thief missile after Q.
Talon.escape: After confirming that Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and E Assassin's Path are down, use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the gap and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Do not go in before dodging the returning blades from Talon W Rake. If Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, the chance to counterattack is clearer.
Talon.fight: Right after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down is an opportunity for Zoe to close the gap. Zoe R Portal Jump can extend the angle for Bubble, but always returns to its starting point, so first secure a position where you can avoid Talon's engage. Look to counterattack once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault has been used.
Talon.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! when you can last-hit and harass at the same time, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Talon steps forward. If Talon disappears, share his location and establish vision along jungle routes.
Talon.phase: In the mid game, Zoe can deal heavy damage when she has items and lands Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Talon's influence falls off in the late game, but Zoe is also vulnerable, so fight from a safe position.
Talon.teamfight: Start in the back line and hit targets affected by your allies' immobilizing effects with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and E Assassin's Path are available, do not move forward. When Talon enters your back line, layer crowd control with your allies.
Talon.watch: The key against Talon W Rake is to move out of the returning blades' path. If the first hit lands, use Zoe W Spell Thief movement speed to dodge the returning blades, and do not chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can go invisible.

TwistedFate.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Since most of Twisted Fate's damage is magic and Zoe has low magic resistance, build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: After landing Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind while waiting for sleep to take hold, then redirect it to hit as the first source of damage during sleep. Follow up with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack, then hit with Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Keep your basic attack or missile from hitting before Q so it doesn't consume sleep's double-damage hit.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card is used is your chance to approach. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns you to your starting point, so check that spot is safe first.
TwistedFate.fight: Avoid direct trades while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card is ready. Look for an angle with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble after he uses the card or holds a blue or red card. If Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, look for a chance to attack from extended range with Zoe R Portal Jump.
TwistedFate.phase: Early-game Zoe has a long cooldown on Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and limited mana, so mistakes are costly; farm safely. Zoe's burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so find a safe position first with Twisted Fate R Destiny in mind.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! on enemies hit by your allies' immobilizing effects. Move forward after confirming Twisted Fate R Destiny has been used; until then, hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. If Twisted Fate uses his gold card, focus your attacks while he has fewer defensive options.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate locks in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range. Take less damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions.

Veigar.build: Most of Veigar's damage is magic, and Zoe has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots.
Veigar.combo: If Veigar E Event Horizon is down, land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then redirect it to land as the first source of damage during sleep. Follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack, then hit with Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility, so the moment after Veigar E Event Horizon is down is your chance to close the distance. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to approach briefly and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, but account for returning to your original position.
Veigar.fight: Look for an opening when Veigar E Event Horizon is down and he has no mobility. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your spell range and set up an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, but account for Zoe R Portal Jump returning you to your starting point by checking where you'll land back.
Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid unnecessary hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and keep moving when you see the indicator for Veigar W Dark Matter. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! when you can last-hit and poke at the same time, and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Veigar steps forward.
Veigar.phase: In the mid game, once Zoe has leveled Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and acquired items, look for a combo after landing a bubble. Veigar grows stronger over time from Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks, so in the late game, set up an angle from a safe position.
Veigar.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! after your allies land immobilizing crowd control. Track whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used, and move forward after the enemy's engage ability is down. Until then, hold your position with traps from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If you're trapped inside, don't run into the edge; move around inside and watch for the ground indicator of Veigar W Dark Matter to dodge it. If your health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Since most of Vex's damage is magic and Zoe has low magic resistance, build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down, land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then redirect it to hit as the first source of damage when Vex wakes. Follow with an empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Vex.escape: If Vex has used even Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on the wave or to poke, there's less risk of your engage being interrupted. Zoe R Portal Jump is not an escape, so keep a safe starting position when Vex can engage.
Vex.fight: Avoid trading head-on; poke with Zoe Q Paddle Star! and look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. When both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down, close the distance with Zoe R Portal Jump and attack. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check where you'll land back before going in.
Vex.laning: Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time, but cast it where it can hit multiple targets so you don't run low on mana. If Vex hasn't stepped forward, save Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble; look for a bubble angle after Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is down. If you've cleared the wave, intervene in another lane with an extended-range bubble from behind the river or jungle wall.
Vex.phase: Zoe's burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so position yourself with Vex R Shadow Surge in mind.
Vex.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and hit enemies affected by your allies' immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Move forward after confirming Vex R Shadow Surge has been fully spent; until then, hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief. Have low-health allies get out of Vex's range first to prevent Vex R Shadow Surge from being recast.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, approaching with Zoe R Portal Jump can get your engage interrupted, so wait until just after Vex uses Doom on the wave or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger over distance, so if you're already within range, dodge with a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you and marks you, move toward your allies to set up a position where you can catch Vex together as she dashes in.

Viktor.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Since most of Viktor's damage is magic and Zoe has low magic resistance, build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: After landing Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind while waiting for sleep to take hold, then redirect it toward Viktor. Make Zoe Q Paddle Star! the first source of damage during sleep, then follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles. Keep the order so your basic attack or missiles don't hit first and consume the first-hit damage trigger.
Viktor.escape: The moment after Viktor W Gravity Field is down is your chance to close the distance with Zoe R Portal Jump. Viktor has no dash to get himself out, but Viktor Q Siphon Power can grant him a shield and movement speed, so account for that when engaging. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so don't count on it as an escape.
Viktor.fight: Instead of trading head-on, dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray to the side and look for an angle to land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If Viktor W Gravity Field is down, you can close the distance and attack with Zoe R Portal Jump, but account for soon returning to your starting point.
Viktor.laning: Pressure Viktor early, before he builds up growth stacks. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to farm and poke at the same time when you can hit both Viktor and minions, and don't cast it too often or you'll run low on mana. After clearing the wave, look for an extended-range angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall.
Viktor.phase: The early game, before Viktor has built any stacks, is the best time to pressure him. After learning Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting one item, Zoe can deal heavy damage with a single hit. Viktor's growth stacks are permanent and make him stronger over time, so in the late game, find a safe position before looking for an attack angle.
Viktor.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and hit targets affected by your allies' immobilizing effects with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Watch for Viktor W Gravity Field and the enemy's engage abilities, and move forward after confirming those engage abilities have been spent. Look for an angle to attack Viktor without stepping into Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in a line with the minion wave; sidestep it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area immediately to avoid being stunned, and don't continue trading inside it. Also watch out for the area damage from Viktor R Arcane Storm.

Vladimir.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Since most of Vladimir's damage is magic and Zoe has low magic resistance, build magic resistance first. If the duel drags on, consider anti-healing next to counter his sustain.
Vladimir.combo: Land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble as Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends. While waiting for sleep, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then redirect it so Q deals the first hit. Follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack, then land Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Vladimir.escape: Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, you have a chance to catch him with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, his movement speed is reduced, so check your range and minion positions before lining up a shot. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your original position, so make sure your return spot is safe before going in.
Vladimir.fight: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool removes projectiles, so bait it out first, then land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. When the pool ends and Vladimir steps forward, deal brief damage with Zoe Q Paddle Star! and empowered basic attacks. You can extend your range with Zoe R Portal Jump, but account for where you'll land back at your starting point.
Vladimir.laning: Look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down or when he steps forward. After clearing the wave, set up an angle to throw a bubble from behind a wall.
Vladimir.phase: After learning Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting an item, Zoe can deal heavy damage by landing a bubble, but Vladimir's health and ability power grow over time. Zoe keeps her burst in the late game, so find a safe position first and wait for an opportunity.
Vladimir.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and cast Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! on top of your allies' immobilizing effects. Spread out so multiple players aren't hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and retreat until the effect ends if you're infected. Move forward after confirming Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has ended and the enemy's engage abilities have been spent.
Vladimir.watch: Keep your distance when Vladimir Q Transfusion is empowered, accounting for its healing and movement speed increase. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you're afflicted by Vladimir R Hemoplague, retreat and fight again after its effect ends.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Xerath's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots, and build magic resistance rather than armor.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down, land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind, then redirect it to hit the sleeping Xerath as the first source of damage. Follow with an empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after both Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to get Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble in range, and check that your starting point is safe to return to.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance while sidestepping Xerath Q Arcanopulse as he charges it. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down, use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range and set up an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zoe R Portal Jump returns you to your starting point, so check where you'll land back before going in.
Xerath.laning: Early on, don't trade head-on; use Zoe Q Paddle Star! to last-hit and poke at the same time. If you farm while avoiding Xerath's heavy damage and don't cast Zoe Q Paddle Star! too often, Xerath will eventually run low on mana first. Push the lane then and call for jungle help.
Xerath.phase: After learning Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting one item, Zoe can deal heavy damage by landing a bubble, so look for an opening when Xerath's crowd control is down. Zoe's burst remains strong in the late game, but her durability barely increases, so find a safe position first.
Xerath.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! on enemies affected by your allies' immobilizing crowd control. If you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge the attack or use it as a chance to attack while Xerath is stuck in place. Before moving forward, check that the enemy's engage abilities have been spent, and hold your position with bubble traps and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Xerath.watch: Be especially careful to dodge Xerath E Shocking Orb, since a stun can leave you open to follow-up attacks. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction with a wide sidestep when you see him charging it. Start dodging immediately when you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo's main damage is physical and Zoe has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Land Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Yasuo W Wind Wall is gone or you have an angle around it. While waiting for sleep to take hold, send Zoe Q Paddle Star! far away, then redirect it to hit as the first source of damage during sleep. Follow with a Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack and Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Yasuo.escape: Engage with crowd control just after Yasuo throws his tornado, while Yasuo R Last Breath is still on cooldown. Use Zoe R Portal Jump to extend your range and set up an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, but account for returning to your starting point. If Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is still available, don't continue the chase too far.
Yasuo.fight: Safely poke off Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield before starting a trade. Look for the moment after Yasuo throws his tornado and his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again, so don't go deep just because one mobility ability is down.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and toward your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can dash through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Use Zoe Q Paddle Star! when you can last-hit and poke at the same time, and look for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Yasuo steps forward. After throwing Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, watch out during its cooldown.
Yasuo.phase: After learning Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and getting one item, Zoe can turn a landed bubble into heavy damage. In the late game, Zoe's burst remains strong but her durability barely increases, so first find a position where you can avoid Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yasuo.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and use Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star! on targets affected by your allies' immobilizing crowd control. Don't move forward until Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and Yasuo R Last Breath have been spent. In the meantime, hold your position with traps from a missed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach through minions, so keep your distance around large minion waves. Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so sidestep it, and watch for a knock-up if his tornado stacks are full. If you're knocked up by Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, Yasuo R Last Breath can follow.

Zed.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zed’s main damage is physical and Zoe has low armor, so build armor first. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier than usual to prepare for Zed R Death Mark engaging on you instantly.
Zed.combo: After hitting Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, wait for the sleep to take hold while sending Zoe Q Paddle Star! far to the side or behind you, then curve it toward Zed. Time its arrival so Zoe Q Paddle Star! deals the first damage while he is asleep. Then hit an empowered Zoe P More Sparkles! basic attack and land Zoe W Spell Thief missiles.
Zed.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Zed W Living Shadow is down, once the shadow disappears or he has finished swapping places. If Zed R Death Mark has not yet come back up, use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the distance and set up an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Choose a position outside the shadow’s range to avoid the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash.
Zed.fight: Look to trade right after Zed uses W Living Shadow, especially once the shadow disappears or Zed has already swapped places. If Zed R Death Mark is still available, don’t commit just because one mobility spell is down. You can use Zoe R Portal Jump to close the distance when engaging, but always account for where you’ll return to.
Zed.laning: Avoid direct trades, and use your abilities only from a position where Zoe Q Paddle Star! can secure last hits and poke at the same time. Look for an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when Zed steps forward, but keep a safe distance while Zed W Living Shadow is available. After clearing the wave, set up an angle for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble from behind a wall to influence a side lane.
Zed.phase: Play safely in the early game, since one mistake is costly for Zoe due to her mana and the long cooldown on Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Zed peaks in the mid game, so build armor from the early game and avoid positions where you can be caught alone. Zed weakens in the late game and Zoe retains her burst, but Zoe is still fragile, so take safe positions with your team.
Zed.teamfight: Start from the farthest back and follow up on targets hit by your allies’ immobilizing crowd control with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Move forward only after confirming Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark have been fully spent. Until then, hold your position using the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and the movement speed from Zoe W Spell Thief.
Zed.watch: Be wary of Zed engaging while Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are available. Zed E Shadow Slash slows from the shadow's position, so move outside its range. If Zed R Death Mark is on you, look for an angle to interrupt his combo with Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble so he cannot deal more damage.
